routes.status: Source registration confirmed by targeted search; mount, authentication and route reachability not exercised.
routes.scope: Fleet-wide operator workspace. Vehicle selector intentionally disabled at web\src\lib\workspaceScope.ts:109-135; route absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS at lines 23-77.

purpose: Coordinate fleet drivers, vehicle assignments, reservations, charging policies, cost centers, maintenance and inferred capacity without reducing the fleet to a single selected vehicle.
primaryGoal: Review loaded multi-vehicle operational records and their source coverage, then safely create, edit, cancel or delete records in live mode.

dataSources.behavior: Fleet-wide vehicle choices; safeArray selection and FAST stale time; forwarded AbortSignal. Empty/loading choices disable the header reservation action.
dataSources.backendVerification: Not inspected or exercised; endpoint is the hook request path, not a claim about backend response correctness.

dataSources.behavior: FleetPage items/total/limit/offset; first 100 records per domain; no vehicle, date or server-offset control passed by page. Shared fleet-ops query keys and inherited query policy; AbortSignal forwarded. Value filters enabled only when offset is zero and total equals loaded length.
dataSources.ownership: Typed API hooks own requests; page owns query orchestration; feature helpers derive loaded-record summaries.
dataSources.backendVerification: Server sorting, maximum limits, total reliability, auth and actual completeness are unknown. Do not treat loaded counts as server-wide totals.

dataSources.behavior: No vehicle_id supplied, so fleet-wide forecast. UTC 14-day window memoized at mount; inferred provenance; preserve quality, history counts, generated_at, limitations and all returned vehicle-day points.
dataSources.backendVerification: Forecast model, history coverage and endpoint bound inclusivity are unknown. No claim that forecast is observed utilization or a guaranteed capacity prediction.

endpoints: PUT /fleet-ops/{resource}/{id} with original version in body
dataSources.behavior: requiresLiveMode true; networkMode always; successful mutations invalidate fleetOpsKeys.all. Cancellation is a versioned reservation PUT preserving the other fields, not a separate invented cancel endpoint.
dataSources.backendVerification: No mutation executed. Conflict detection, enforcement, atomicity, referential deletion constraints and driver guardrail enforcement are not proved.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Named edit/delete icon-button pairs repeat in DriverRoster, AssignmentRoster, ChargingPolicyMatrix, CostCenterAllocation and WorkOrderBoard. ReservationActions already centralizes the reservation-specific three-action pattern.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep domain callbacks and cancel eligibility local; reuse an existing shared action pattern if its named/disabled/44px contract fits. Otherwise consolidate only the proven repeated presentation after broader inventory evidence, not a speculative new global component.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Six content sections use the same loading skeleton, fatal error/retry and contextual empty-state branching. Existing feedback components are reused; this is repeated orchestration, not evidence of a competing state system.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Retain independent state surfaces; only adopt an existing shared content-state composition if it preserves section titles, actions, geometry and retry.

responsive.currentSourceStrategy: Page sections stack until xl; the roster/allocation group becomes two columns. Reservation day cards reflow 1/2/5 columns; maintenance lanes become five columns at xl, otherwise stack. Several feature children use min-w-0 and break-words. All four DataTables specify three mobile-visible columns.

issues.rule: MDC-023 / MDC-043 / no mobile information loss
issues.detail: mobileColumns retains only vehicle/policy/actions, hiding target SoC, max power, allowed windows and enabled state below md. The other three tables similarly hide driver/status/period, assignment start/end and driver guardrails. DataTable.tsx:725 implements hidden md:table-cell; no mobilePresentation or expanded detail renderer is passed by these callers.
issues.fix: Use the existing mobilePresentation contract with allDetails and inlineActions to preserve every field, or retain a deliberate scrollable complete matrix. Preserve table IDs, loaded pagination/filter/export ownership and all actions. Do not require write mode to read hidden details.

issues.detail: Cost-center title and a non-wrapping status-plus-two-actions row share flex width; action controls alone require roughly 88px plus status and gaps. The title wrapper lacks min-w-0, creating a narrow-card/long-name overflow risk. This is source risk, not a reproduced viewport defect.
issues.fix: Allow header reflow, give the title column min-w-0 and deliberate wrapping, and retain status and both 44px named actions at 320px and narrow allocated card widths.

responsive.verification: No browser or viewport exercises. 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920/2560, allocated-container widths, RTL, 200% text, long labels and touch overlap remain unverified.

issues.detail: vehiclesQuery is omitted from PageLayout.query and has no fatal error/initial-loading surface. Its StaleRefreshWarning at line 140 returns null without retained data (StaleRefreshWarning.tsx:60). A first-load vehicle failure therefore leaves New reservation disabled without a named vehicle error/retry; other vehicle-backed editors receive empty choices.
issues.fix: Add a source-specific initial failure/loading notice with retry and explicit choice-unavailable state; do not replace independent operational sections or reinterpret a failed vehicle source as an empty fleet.

issues.detail: Cost-center panel loading combines cost centers, reservations and work orders; error combines all three fatal errors. CostCenterAllocation.tsx:55-64 then replaces the entire panel, hiding successfully loaded cost-center identities and edit/delete controls when only an aggregate dependency fails.
issues.fix: Preserve usable cost-center records and actions while marking reservation/order-derived allocations unavailable with independent retry/context. Never calculate fabricated zeros from failed dependencies.

issues.detail: Empty text says no reservations in this planning window, but the page passes only limit=100 and no from/to. It is an undated loaded operational list, as FleetKpis.tsx:81 explicitly describes.
issues.fix: Align empty copy with the actual returned list scope; preserve the independent 14-day forecast window and do not imply server date filtering.

states.verification: Initial/empty/partial/refresh-error/offline/as-of/success/disabled/conflict branches are source-inspected only. No fixtures or mutations run; existing tests are not borrowed runtime proof.

visualIssues.detail: Fixed text-amber-300 cancel and text-rose-300 delete styling overrides semantic shared button treatment. Similar fixed rose-300 classes repeat across five resource views and charging-window removal. These are meaningful danger/warning cues, not decorative neon, but theme contrast is not established.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing theme-aware semantic danger/warning styling where applicable; retain labels, distinction and target sizing. Measure composed light/dark contrast rather than simply choosing a different fixed saturation.

visualIssues.detail: Ad-hoc text-sm paragraph remains despite shared Text; charging-window legend/body likewise use text-sm/font-semibold at ChargingWindowsEditor.tsx:38,46.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing Text/role wrappers with semantic element overrides; retain alert role and valid fieldset semantics.

visualIssues.detail: A two-column inner grid contains bookings, maintenance-cost paragraph and open-orders as three unlike cells, producing an asymmetric hierarchy with a further mt-3 on maintenance cost. This is source layout evidence, not a screenshot assessment.
visualIssues.fix: Use consistent label/value grouping and responsive geometry for all three values without dropping monetary context or inventing metrics.

architectureIssues.detail: Six lists load limit=100 with no UI-driven server offset; table pagination only paginates loaded items. Summary discloses partial reservations/assignments/work orders, but driver/policy views, choice lists and cost-center aggregates do not expose complete per-source total/offset coverage. Records beyond the first batch may be unreachable; actual server volume is unknown.
architectureIssues.fix: Display loaded/source coverage per affected domain and distinguish incomplete choices/aggregates. If full result navigation is required, integrate the existing typed offset filters and explicit total metadata; coordinate integration before claiming complete backend results.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-045 / unknown is not measured zero
architectureIssues.detail: Allocation sums null cost_minor as zero, and mixes all related orders before selecting a single currency. Mixed currencies yield no displayed amount, while null-valued costs with one known currency can appear as a definite subtotal. formatMinorUnits at lines 102-104 always divides by 100 for any supplied currency. Backend minor-unit contract and completeness are unverified.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve raw monetary fields and current behavior as a baseline, then resolve unknown-cost/partial-coverage/multi-currency semantics with the data owner. Use existing source-aware currency formatting only after equivalence is established; do not silently change calculations during cosmetic migration.

architectureIssues.detail: Calendar groups starts_at by raw ISO date prefix, chooses first five unique dates in incoming order, and formats times through display helpers. The list is not necessarily sorted by date in inspected frontend source; UTC/source-day grouping may disagree with displayed local time near midnight. Backend ordering and timezone conventions are unknown.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve full reservation table and original instants; verify intended business-day/timezone ordering before adapting calendar grouping. Do not replace independent reservation dates with workspace range controls.

priority.reason: Operator-critical page already uses the current architecture and restrained surfaces; modernization should prioritize read-only access to complete mobile details, dependency-failure recovery and truthful loaded coverage over decorative replacement.
order: Preserve multi-vehicle workflows and concurrency guards

competingImplementations.detail: No competing table, query client, overlay, theme, token, formatter or workspace selection engine observed in the assigned page and inspected dependencies. Existing feature rosters/calendar/board are domain presentations, not evidence of a rival design system.
competingImplementations.fix: Reuse DataTable.mobilePresentation, semantic Button variants, Text wrappers, PageLayout, OperationalBrief and current trust/overlay APIs; no new shared component requested by this evidence.

Work-order allowed transitions and terminal states from WorkOrderDialog.tsx:29-35,115-128.
Per-source retry, stale refresh, aggregate dependency retry, conflict refresh and retained-data recovery.

Four table loaded-result pagination/value filters/column layout and inherited CSV/JSON export scope; preserve IDs fleet-ops:reservations, fleet-ops:drivers, fleet-ops:assignments, fleet-ops:charging-policies.
Forecast ChartCard exportable data, data-table alternative and stable chartKey fleet-ops-utilization. Additional shared chart controls are not inspected or claimed.
dataBehavior: Keep fleet-wide reads and local per-record vehicle/driver selection; do not substitute a shell-selected single vehicle. Header vehicle/range selection intentionally does not scope these operational lists.
Eight independent requests and retained payloads; six loaded lists capped at 100; true source totals/offsets must remain distinct from loaded counts and local filters.

Four KPIs: requested/confirmed reservation count; distinct loaded assignment vehicle IDs, not currently active assignment count; nonterminal loaded orders; arithmetic mean of returned forecast vehicle-day utilization rounded to one decimal. helpers.ts:16-36.

Forecast UTC midnight-to-plus-14-days window is frozen per mount. Aggregate forecast groups by date and averages expected/lower/upper across returned vehicles, rounds to one decimal and derives band width. helpers.ts:76-99.

Read-only/as-of/offline write blocking, editor target clearing, original optimistic concurrency versions and live-mode request guards survive. No claims that these operational lists are historical snapshots.
Reservation driver must be assigned to selected vehicle for the entire period; vehicle changes clear selected driver. ReservationFields.tsx:55-67,102; ReservationDialog.tsx:75-81.
Retain inactive existing assignment-driver/cost-center choices when editing, plus client validation, nullable fields, full-period checks, guardrails and terminal-state restrictions.

Charging policy max_power_w and work-order due_odometer_m remain SI; display conversion uses useUnits, and WorkOrderDialog.tsx:57-59,185 converts editor distance to/from SI at the boundary. cost_minor/currency stay raw wire fields.

Charging windows preserve weekday/local-time values, overnight wrap and overlap validation. chargingWindowUtils.ts:15-40. Preserve device-local date form conversions in formUtils.ts:1-12 until timezone semantics are owner-resolved.

Cancellation preserves reservation vehicle/driver/cost center/title/purpose/start/end while changing status; delete/update preserve original version. All successful fleet mutations invalidate the existing fleet-ops key.
